title: A review on low-concentration electrolytes for rechargeable batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE06096B, Review Article
Lin Liu, Zi-Jian Chen, Guo-Yu Zhu, Bai-Hua Huang, Bo Wang, Yu Yao, De-Shan Bin, Xianhong Rui, Yan Yu
Due to their lower cost, better wettability, and more salt options, low concentration electrolytes (LCEs) have inspired numerous interests. This review outlines the current knowledge on the design and application of LCEs in rechargeable batteries.
